scope: Independent memory sub-measurement: each (method, trajectory_kind, arm, repeat) is measured in its own fresh Python subprocess that imports horizon.town_cache / horizon.town_region fresh and is handed only a small request (arm name, two container paths, one trajectory's ROI list, one expected sha256) -- never the full map array and never the full schedule file. warm_buffered only. resident_decoded_bytes_* is the arm's own exact retained-array ledger (.resident_bytes); tracemalloc_*_bytes is traced Python/NumPy heap activity only, measured after imports+gc.collect(), split into startup (constructor) and movement (replay loop) phases with peak reset between them; process_rss_*_hwm_bytes is the absolute, monotonically non-decreasing OS RSS high-water mark for the whole process, not an attributable cache cost. None of this is a claim about physically cold SSD/controller reads; warm_buffered only describes this process priming the OS page cache once before each repeat. Only one output array is ever live per load step.
